---
title: "How many measurements are missing and how do I exclude them from a mean?"
---

## What the question asks

How many measurements are missing and how do I exclude them from a mean?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Count is.na(x).

2. Decide whether the remaining observations answer the question.

3. Compute mean(x,na.rm=TRUE) and report the denominator.

## Runnable example

```{r}
x <- c(8,12,NA,14,16,NA)
print(sum(is.na(x)))
print(sum(!is.na(x)))
print(mean(x,na.rm=TRUE))
```

## Interpret the result

Two of six observations are missing; the observed-value mean is 12.5, calculated from four values. It is not the mean of all six measurements.

## Check before applying this to real data

Report how many values were missing. Do not treat an unavailable observation as zero.
